name: hud_stack_late_press_race_latency_4
description: A press late in a build window online, at 4 turns of latency each way (200 ms), racing a rival on its own hollow (M8's review; design 2.7 and 5.7). An order lands later than offline: after the turns the game holds and has not run yet (TurnSource.order_lead) by its trip there and back (MatchClient.rtt_ms in whole turns: Game.order_trip), and the horn's question counted only the first, so a press with more of the countdown left than the order's lead and a turn went out at once, landed after the window's horn and was taken as a call for wave 2, so one press called waves 1 and 2. Now the press asks for a second and sends nothing; a second press still in the window is the call for wave 2, which waits for the window's horn here and goes out after it naming wave 2 (a READY sent at once would name wave 1 and be refused): the horn brings wave 1, the call brings wave 2 onto the road with it, and only that one READY went out.

steps.assert: Game.sim.hollows[0].countdown_t > lead + 3 and Game.order_trip() == 24 and Game.late_in_window()
steps.msg: more of the window left than the order's lead and a turn, less than those and the 24-tick trip

steps.assert: scene.controller.call_armed() and node('Notice').text == 'Call wave 2 now? Press again' and scene.settled() and node('LoopbackMain').sealed('READY') == 0
steps.msg: the press asks for a second and sends nothing

steps.assert: Game.state == 0 and scene.controller.wants_ready() and not scene.settled() and node('LoopbackMain').sealed('READY') == 0
steps.msg: the second press in the window waits for its horn

steps.assert: Game.waves_on_road() == PackedInt32Array([1, 2]) and node('LoopbackMain').sealed('READY') == 1 and node('LoopbackMain').sealed_turns('READY')[0] * 3 > horn
steps.msg: it went out after the horn, named wave 2 and called it

steps.assert: not Game.is_ready() and scene.settled() and not scene.controller.call_armed()
steps.msg: alone its horn sounded as it landed: nothing waits
